grammar_focus: 易混词辨析复习(主考:borrow 借入 / lend 借出 · its 它的 / it's = it is · exciting 令人激动 / excited 感到激动 · beside 在旁 / besides 除…外 · remind 提醒 / remember 记得 · home / house · police 用复数)+ What a…! 感叹句 / It could be worse(辅考)
scene: 在饭店经理办公室报失 50 美元,经理深表同情却无能为力、正抱怨世道不古——一个姑娘送来装着 50 美元的信封:'在这位先生房门外捡到的。'这世上到底还是有诚实可言!

grammar_card.title: 易混词复习:一字之差,意思大不同
grammar_card.intro: 本课复习一批容易搞混的词:borrow / lend、its / it's、exciting / excited、beside / besides、remind / remember 等,再复习 What a…! 感叹句。全用本课句子举例。

rows: borrow 借入 ↔ lend 借出
Can I borrow your pen? / Lend me your pen.
its 它的 ↔ it's = it is / it has
The dog wagged its tail. / It's raining.
exciting 令人激动(修饰物)↔ excited 感到激动(修饰人)
an exciting game / the excited children
beside 在…旁边 ↔ besides 除…之外

specialRules.rule: remind sb 提醒别人 ↔ remember 自己记得:Please remind me to call.
感叹句 What a + 名词!:What a wonderful garden!

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Had the writer's money been stolen?
options: No, an honest girl found it outside his room
No, he had just spent it

passage: I entered the hotel manager's office and sat down. I had just lost $50 and I felt very upset. 'I left the money in my room,' I said, 'and it's not there now.' The manager was sympathetic, but he could do nothing. 'Everyone's losing money these days,' he said. He started to complain about this wicked world but was interrupted by a knock at the door. A girl came in and put an envelope on his desk. It contained $50. 'I found this outside this gentleman's room,' she said. 'Well,' I said to the manager, 'there is still some honesty in this world!'
